findings.issue: Six turns fumbling the create-solid CLI's non-interactive flags (3 failed invocations) before reverse-engineering them from the minified bundle
findings.suggestion: Inspect the CLI's arg parser or docs once, then scaffold; or hand-write the small project files directly since the scaffold is tiny

findings.issue: pkill/pgrep -f patterns matched its own bash command line and killed the shell twice, wasting test-run cycles
findings.suggestion: Use ps -eo pid,args | grep -v grep | awk '{print $1}' | xargs -r kill (adopted later) or exclude the current PID from the start

findings.issue: Sort fix keeps onClick on both th and nested button with stopPropagation — a defensive workaround for the early-click race whose root cause (event-handler timing on first render) was never fully pinned down
findings.suggestion: Root-cause the delegation timing or use a single handler on the th only; document why both exist

findings.issue: TypeScript project never typechecked (0 tsc runs; vite build skips type errors)
findings.suggestion: Add a typecheck script (vue-tsc equivalent / tsc --noEmit) and run it before declaring done

findings.issue: Wrote MoveTable with knowingly-broken sort logic (undefined cmp/cmpResult) and rewrote it immediately
findings.suggestion: Write the comparator correctly the first time; the correct version was only ~20 lines

findings.issue: File writes via bash heredocs (20 of them) caused one truncated temp spec; write tool used only 3 times
findings.suggestion: Use the write tool for multi-line files; reserve heredocs for throwaway probe scripts

findings.issue: Removed the hero section's aria-label only after all 54 tests passed — a spec-conformance detail ('one main landmark', region roles) discovered late in review
findings.suggestion: Audit landmark structure against the spec during initial implementation, not post-pass

summary: A disciplined autonomous session: current-doc verification before coding, a reasoned architecture, systematic instrumentation-driven debugging of both real failures, and a clean rebuild plus visual screenshot comparison as final verification. The main waste was tooling fumbling — scaffold CLI flags, a twice-repeated self-kill pattern, and heredoc writes — plus a never-run typecheck on a TS codebase. Net: solid senior-engineer process with avoidable friction, landing just below exemplary.
